method: Test-only lower-version app invokes unchanged production check/install/cancel/relaunch commands with the public feed and embedded updater key. After replacement, the unmodified public RC1 binary runs its built-in native acceptance.
observerNotes: Initial launch through /tmp was rejected by the upstream executable symlink guard; successful run used canonical /private/tmp paths.

The first supervisor reached post-restart validation, then failed its camelCase byte-count assertion. This read-only verifier evaluates the saved raw events; the field mismatch is retained as a real RC1 UI defect, not hidden as a passing contract.
limitations: The old version is a test-only fixture, not a previously released binary.
Programmatic native commands; no manual updater UI acceptance.
